purpose: Operational plan for enabling Beta slot generation at runtime in a controlled, reversible manner. Planning artifact only; no production flag changes in Phase 5 Step 1.
preconditions: Phase 4 slot generation interface and executor contracts are locked and CI-green
Kill-switch dominance is proven (SLOTGEN_AI_KILL=true forces STUB)
Allowlist deny-by-default policy remains in force until explicitly enabled
enableOrder: Confirm FEATURE_SLOTGEN_AI=true for target environment while kill-switch remains ON
Enable allowlist with minimal cohort rule set (smallest safe scope)
Set SLOTGEN_AI_ROLLOUT_PERCENT via canary progression (0 -> 1 -> 5) only when stable
Verify telemetry and health after each step
Disable kill-switch (SLOTGEN_AI_KILL=false) only after all checks pass
verification: path=stub when blocked; path=openai only when all gates pass
Error code distribution is expected (KILL_SWITCH, NOT_ALLOWLISTED, ROLLOUT_EXCLUDED, or OpenAI path outcomes)
Latency remains within accepted bounds for the current rollout level
rollback: Halt progression and set SLOTGEN_AI_KILL=true (instant STUB everywhere)
Reduce SLOTGEN_AI_ROLLOUT_PERCENT to 0 or disable allowlist
All changes must be reversible within one operator action
